newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - private.

text.p: Nebraska's feedlot cattle owners and packer buyers were at a standoff, with a $2.00 to $3.00 per cwt spread between bids and offers, private sources and USDA said.
Packer bids of $108.00 to $109.00 per cwt on a dressed basis were passed by owners pricing cattle at $110.00 to $112.00, they said.

The bulk of last week's sales were at $111.00 although the most recent established market was Thursday at $110.00 to $111.00, USDA said. This week's showlist was estimated near 68,000 head, up 3,000 from last week, market sources said.
